items.title: GraphAgents: Knowledge Graph-Guided Agentic AI for Cross-Domain Materials Design
items.title_zh: GraphAgents：知识图谱引导的跨领域材料设计智能体
items.summary: GraphAgents is a multi-agent framework guided by large-scale knowledge graphs in which agents specialize in problem decomposition, evidence retrieval, design-parameter extraction and graph traversal to search for sustainable PFAS substitutes. Ablations show the full pipeline beats single-shot prompting, and by tailoring traversal the system alternates exploitative searches with exploratory ones; a biomedical tubing example yields PFAS-free design candidates balancing tribological performance, thermal stability, chemical resistance and biocompatibility.

items.title: Agent-Fence: Mapping Security Vulnerabilities Across Deep Research Agents
items.title_zh: Agent-Fence：绘制深度研究智能体的安全漏洞图谱
items.summary: AgentFence is an architecture-centric security evaluation that defines 14 trust-boundary attack classes across planning, memory, retrieval, tool use and delegation, and detects failures through trace-auditable conversation breaks. Holding the base model fixed, eight agent archetypes showed mean security break rates from 0.29 (LangGraph) to 0.51 (AutoGPT), with Denial-of-Wallet, authorization confusion, retrieval poisoning and planning manipulation the highest-risk classes.

items.title: AD-MIR: Bridging the Gap from Perception to Persuasion in Advertising Video Understanding via Structured Reasoning
items.title_zh: AD-MIR：通过结构化推理弥合广告视频理解中的感知与说服鸿沟
items.summary: AD-MIR builds a structure-aware memory from raw advertising video by combining semantic retrieval with exact keyword matching, then uses a structured reasoning agent that decomposes the narrative and validates insights against specific frames with evidence-based self-correction. On the AdsQA benchmark it surpasses the strongest general-purpose agent by 1.8% strict and 9.5% relaxed accuracy.

items.title: Developing an AI Assistant for Knowledge Management and Workforce Training in State DOTs
items.title_zh: 面向州交通部门知识管理与员工培训的 AI 助手
items.summary: The paper proposes a retrieval-augmented generation framework with specialized agents for retrieval, answer generation, evaluation and query refinement to help state transportation agencies preserve institutional expertise and train staff. An open-weight vision-language model converts technical figures into semantic text so figure-based knowledge can be indexed and retrieved alongside documents before an open-weight LLM generates grounded answers.

items.title: Efficient Table Retrieval and Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 基于多模态大模型的高效表格检索与理解
items.summary: TabRAG answers queries over large collections of table images by retrieving candidate tables with jointly trained visual-text foundation models, reranking them with MLLMs, then reasoning over the selected tables. On a newly constructed dataset of 88,161 training and 9,819 test samples across eight benchmarks it improves retrieval recall by 7.0% and answer accuracy by 6.1%.

items.title: ParisKV: Fast and Drift-Robust KV-Cache Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs
items.title_zh: ParisKV：面向长上下文 LLM 的快速抗漂移 KV 缓存检索
items.summary: ParisKV is a GPU-native KV-cache retrieval framework that pairs collision-based candidate selection with quantized inner-product reranking for long-context LLMs. It reports up to 2.8x higher throughput and decode-latency reductions of 17x and 44x versus MagicPIG and PQCache at million-token scale.

items.title: Knowledge Graph and Hypergraph Transformers with Repository-Attention and Journey-Based Role Transport
items.title_zh: 基于仓库注意力与旅程式角色传输的知识图谱和超图 Transformer
items.summary: The paper presents an architecture that encodes knowledge graphs and hypergraphs into a key-value repository over which a language transformer can attend, keeping linguistic and structured knowledge representations separable while linking them through cross-attention.

items.title: matt1398/claude-devtools
items.title_zh: matt1398/claude-devtools：Claude Code 的开发者工具
items.summary: Claude DevTools is a free, open-source TypeScript tool with a visual interface for inspecting Claude Code session logs, tool calls, token usage, subagents and context window.
